body: ### Features - **@modelcontextprotocol/sdk:** Capture MCP tool call intent [#11319](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11319) - **AI Guard:** Accept MCP server metadata in the SDK evaluate call [#11384](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11384) - **AppSec:** Express v5 normalized route followup [#11301](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11301) - **Data Streams Monitoring:** Emit data streams checkpoints for http client and server [#11211](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11211) - **OpenTelemetry:** Default OTLP trace export to http/protobuf [#11344](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11344) - **OpenTelemetry:** Support http/protobuf for OTLP trace export [#11305](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11305) - **Serverless:** Extract upstream context for shim invocations [#11246](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11246) ### Fixes - **AI Guard:** Log a thrown value that is not an Error without throwing [#11306](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11306) - **AppSec:** Block RASP matches when a library wraps the abort error [#11335](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11335) - **AppSec:** Skip binary values and inherited keys when tainting database rows [#11367](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11367) - **azure-functions:** Apply OTel HTTP semantics to HTTP triggers [#10884](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10884) - **azure-functions:** Include host prefixes in HTTP routes [#11346](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11346) - **Feature Flags:** Keep the process alive while provider initialization is pending [#11393](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11393) - **General:** Register synchronous hooks without require(esm) [#11296](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11296) - **General:** Treat empty OTEL_PROPAGATORS as unset [#11327](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11327) - **graphql:** Support graphql-jit 0.10 [#11374](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11374) - **OpenTelemetry:** Export integers outside the int64 range as doubles [#11313](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11313) - **runtime:** Avoid native startup failures on Bun [#11267](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11267) - **Test Optimization:** Keep Failed Test Replay working after a probe fails to set or remove [#11323](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11323) - **tracer:** Avoid loading async storage in the no-op tracer [#11348](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11348) ### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking) - **all-green:** Link uploaded junit tests to their pipeline [#11386](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11386) - **General:** [SINT-INT] Switch datadog api key exchange to workload identity federation [#11349](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11349) - **LLM Observability:** Activate the Vercel AI SDK through Orchestrion [#11316](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11316) - **router:** Gate request-local route tests by fixture version [#11371](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11371) - **Test Optimization:** Isolate output dirs of active test span runs [#11358](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11358) - **Test Optimization:** Isolate output dirs of ATR runs [#11368](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11368) - **Test Optimization:** Isolate output dirs of zero-test session runs [#11405](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11405) ### Contributors [](https://github.com/arnaudpy) [](https://github.com/avara1986) [](https://github.com/BridgeAR) [](https://github.com/CarlesDD) [](https://github.com/cgcote) [](https://github.com/datadog-bits) [](https://github.com/Eleee28) [](https://github.com/genesor) [](https://github.com/IlyasShabi) [](https://github.com/joeyzhao2018) [](https://github.com/johannbotha) [](https://github.com/link04) [](https://github.com/marcotc) [](https://github.com/matbrwn) [](https://github.com/mz1119) [](https://github.com/pabloerhard) [](https://github.com/tlhunter) [](https://github.com/vpellan) [](https://github.com/watson)
